contexts.text: A son of an ox, tender and good ()... It is called tender from the Celestial Spiritual, or the truth of good.
The quality of their tender understanding...
The children are tender () = truths which have not yet obtained Divine Life... Tender = what is recent, and thus what has acquired some life, but not yet genuine. Explained.

Heavenly conjugial love exists when a man, together with his wife whom he loves most tenderly, and with his children, lives content in the Lord. From this he has in this world an inward pleasantness, and in the other life heavenly joy.
I perceived such a tenderness of gladness from them...
Infants (there) have a like tenderness of all things...
They had loved infants from a tenderness as it were maternal.
They were heard as a tender inordinated [sound].
The intelligence of women is... soft, delicate.

Those who have lived together in love truly conjugial... are not separated by the death of the one, since the spirit of the deceased partner dwells continually with the spirit of the one not yet deceased, and this until the death of the latter, when they meet again and reunite and love each other more tenderly than before because in the spiritual world.
The beauty of a woman dwells in soft delicacy...
I perceived the tenderness of this Spirit.

What the feminine is, and what the masculine, interiorly. The feminine, interiorly, is to lover the husband tenderly - but they desire the husband to be ignorant of this... The wives of the angels said that I must not disclose this, but I said I would reveal it. This was because they suppose that this was their weakness; but it is the very good of truth and truth of good.

As woman is beautiful, so she is tender; and as she is tender, so she has the ability to perceive the delights of conjugial love; and as she is able to perceive these delights, so she is a faithful custodian of the common good, and as she is a custodian of the common good and the man is wise, so she looks after the prosperity and happiness of the home. MarriageInd2 95.
